context:
Goal: a lane whose PR conflicts with main after a batch gets back into the next batch fast.
Problem (rule): the coordinator let a fresh reviewer read only the resolved lines of a conflicted main merge, but your Nov 10 14:07 CST ruling ("any other difference keeps today's rules") means such a head owes a full review.
Based on (ruling): decisions/pr-review-record, owner 2026-11-10 14:07 CST: "any other difference keeps today's rules"; this re-asks it because the coordinator wants conflicted lanes back in a batch faster.
Based on (read): the merge tool's fix-check route already accepts a reviewer of only the changed lines on such a head; it does not check when the review log was written, so a hand-edited log passes.
Departs from: main, where a conflicted main merge owes a full review — a review of only the resolved lines carries it when the merge's first parent is the reviewed head.
Meanwhile: runner 10 holds any conflicted-merge head that has only a review of the resolved lines.

options.gain: Conflicted lanes rejoin a batch in minutes, not after a full review round.
options.how: After a conflicted main merge, a fresh reviewer reads only the lines the merge resolved, recorded as a fix check on the reviewed head; then the PR rejoins a batch.
options.label: Review the resolved lines only (Recommended)
options.lose: A bad resolution outside the resolved lines is caught only by CI.

options.gain: Today's safety: the whole change is read again.
options.how: A conflicted main merge gets a full review round, as today.
options.label: Keep the full review
options.lose: Each conflicted lane waits a full review round before its next batch.

reply: Closed by triage: your Nov 10 14:07 CST ruling already decides this. Decision pr-review-record says a clean merge of main keeps the review record, and a conflicted merge takes one more fix verifier. So option a holds without a new pick. Asked by mistake.
short: Hunk-only review after a conflict merge
title: After a conflicted main merge, may a review of only the resolved lines carry the change?
why: Your Nov 10 ruling keeps today's rules for any other difference, so a full review is owed unless you say otherwise.
